crop.recommendation: Crop measured chrome rather than removing it from layout: the lyric area retains its exact screen rectangle.

seeking.recommendation: Preview while dragging and seek once on release; keyboard changes seek immediately. This avoids repeatedly interrupting media decoding.

gestureSlop.recommendation: Use a small movement threshold before capturing the pointer: minor tap jitter activates controls; a deliberate button drag moves without activating.

hardNavigation.recommendation: Keep the one audio element in the shared root layout and use Next Link. A document navigation intentionally starts a new inactive session.
